hint_admin_channel: where new-chat verification codes are relayed
hint_command_network: lets run_command use network: true · off forces offline commands
hint_compact: drop older messages, keep the summary
hint_device: browser sign-in opened; or open this page on another device and enter the code
hint_discord_channel: relays chats through your Discord bot
hint_hook_network: lets hooks reach the network · off runs hooks offline
hint_lan_access: other devices on your network can use the API without a password · turn it off when done
hint_launch_on_login: writes a launch agent · applies at your next login, never touches the running daemon
hint_official_guide: injects the vendor prompting guide for the active model · applies from the next message
hint_paste: after signing in, paste the code xAI shows here
hint_priority_note_auto: Fallback under auto only — this order does not change which agent gets selected; after it fails, every other entry is tried top to bottom,
hint_priority_note_cache: Cache never carries across providers, but keep copies of the same model adjacent anyway: capability then steps down instead of jumping.
hint_priority_note_handoff: A hand-off walks downward and never back up, so the last entry is your final line of defense.
hint_reply_language: replies follow it first, this web UI uses it too · auto follows each message, the web UI follows the browser
hint_reset: clear every message in this session
hint_self_id: a-z 0-9 _ - only, up to 32 characters · stored lowercase
hint_summary_memory: rebuild the rolling summary of this conversation
hint_task: fire times · local date and time
hint_telegram_channel: relays chats through your Telegram bot
hint_unreachable: check that the daemon is running
hint_update: opens a terminal to install the latest release
label_always_allow: always allow · pick the tools that skip the confirmation prompt
label_chats_empty: none yet · message the bot and enter the verification code
label_cron_empty: at least one cron expression is required
label_enter_code: enter this code in the browser
label_no_models_returned: no models returned by this provider
label_no_session: no session available · start a chat first
label_no_tools: no tools · connect the server to see them
label_pick_models: %s · pick the models this agent can use
label_reason: Why not? Tell it what to do instead (enter to skip)
label_task_empty: at least one fire time is required
placeholder_content_role: The system prompt this role applies
placeholder_headers: headers · key: value per line · a bare Authorization value gets a Bearer prefix
placeholder_input: How can I help you today?
placeholder_name_schedule: skill folder name · A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - only, e.g. daily-hn-digest
placeholder_paste: code, or the full callback URL
placeholder_redirect: Paste the redirect URL if the browser cannot reach it
placeholder_value: value · stored in the OS keychain, never shown again
placeholder_value_replace: new value · replaces the stored one
title_source: skill source · unchecked sources are not scanned
title_trust: trust · picked skills pass every read and write without asking; only sudo still asks
